import java.util.*;
import java.math.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_SIZE = 33;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;

    static class Matrix {
        long[][] data = new long[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];

        Matrix() {
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SIZE; i++) {
                Arrays.fill(data[i], 0);
            }
        }
    }

    static Matrix multiplyMatrices(Matrix m1, Matrix m2, int size) {
        Matrix result = new Matrix();
        for (int i = 0; i <= size; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= size; ++j) {
                long sum = 0;
                for (int p = 0; p <= size; ++p) {
                    sum = (sum + m1.data[i][p] * m2.data[p][j]) % MOD;
                }
                result.data[i][j] = sum;
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        int k = sc.nextInt();

        Matrix baseAns = new Matrix();
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; ++i)
            baseAns.data[i][i] = 1;

        List<Matrix> transition = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int p = 0; p < k; ++p) {
            Matrix mat = new Matrix();
            for (int i = 0; i <= k; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= k; ++j) {
                    mat.data[i][j] = (i == j || i == p) ? 1 : 0;
                }
            }
            transition.add(mat);
        }

        List<Integer> digits = new ArrayList<>();
        long tempN = n;
        while (tempN > 0) {
            digits.add((int)(tempN % k));
            tempN /= k;
        }
        digits.add(0);
        Collections.reverse(digits);
        // partial sum
        for (int i = digits.size() - 2; i >= 0; --i) {
            digits.set(i, digits.get(i) + digits.get(i + 1));
        }

        for (int p = 0; p + 1 < digits.size(); ++p) {
            for (int i = digits.get(p) - 1; i >= digits.get(p + 1); --i) {
                baseAns = multiplyMatrices(transition.get(i % k), baseAns, k);
            }
            List<Matrix> pre = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Matrix> suf = new ArrayList<>();
            pre.add(transition.get(0));
            for (int i = 1; i < k; ++i) {
                pre.add(multiplyMatrices(pre.get(i - 1), transition.get(i), k));
            }
            suf.add(transition.get(k - 1));
            for (int i = k - 2; i >= 0; --i) {
                suf.add(0, multiplyMatrices(transition.get(i), suf.get(0), k));
            }
            baseAns = multiplyMatrices(suf.get(0), baseAns, k);
            for (int i = 1; i < k; ++i) {
                baseAns = multiplyMatrices(suf.get(i), pre.get(i - 1), k);
            }
        }

        long total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; ++i) {
            total += baseAns.data[i][k];
        }
        System.out.println(total % MOD);
        sc.close();
    }
}
